description: Prometheus Alertmanager webhook for SRE remediation goals.

goal_template.objective_template: Investigate Prometheus alert {{alertname}} for {{service}} in {{environment}}. Use memory_context for service={{service}}, alert={{alertname}}, fingerprint={{payload:/_coat_observability/fingerprint}}, and subject={{subject}} to determine whether this is recurring or persistent. If memory and current evidence show a code, config, dashboard, or runbook fix is justified, produce a reviewable branch or PR with tests or validation evidence. If the right action is operational rather than code, return dashboard, alert-tuning, runbook, or follow-up trigger artifacts. Runbook: {{runbook_url}}. Dashboard: {{dashboard_url}}.
